test_title: PYST 42: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Three taps A, B and C together can fill an empty cistern in 20 minutes. Tap A alone can fill it in 50 minutes and tap B alone in 60 minutes. How long will tap C alone take to fill it (in minutes)?
solution:
**Given:**

A + B + C can fill in 20 min

A alone = 50 min

B alone = 60 min

**Formula used:**

Work per min = 1 / Time

(A + B + C) work/min = A work/min + B work/min + C work/min

**Calculation:**

A work/min = 1/50

B work/min = 1/60

(A + B + C) work/min = 1/20

⇒ 1/20 = 1/50 + 1/60 + 1/C

⇒ 1/20 - (1/50 + 1/60) = 1/C

⇒ 1/20 - 11/300 = 1/C

⇒ (15 - 11)/300 = 1/C

⇒ 4/300 = 1/C

⇒ C = 75

**∴ Tap C alone will take 75 minutes.**
